Testing is a crucial part of software development. It involves checking that code works as expected before users encounter it. There are different types of tests. Unit tests check small, individual parts of the code, like a single function. Integration tests check how different parts of the system work together.

Many developers use a method called test-driven development. In this approach, you write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to make it pass, and finally improve the code. This process helps create higher-quality software.

Ultimately, testing gives developers confidence. It allows them to change or add features without fear of breaking something that already works. Good testing practices save time and reduce stress in the long run.
